DOP: āyava n. [ from āyu], liveliness, energy ; Paṭis I 107, 24 (appattassa pattiyā atthi ~aṃ, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce āsavaṃ; Paṭis-a 338, 2 : atthi ~an ti atthi viriyaṃ, āyāvan ti pi pāṭho) ≠ S V 13, 6 ( Be, Ee āyāmaṃ; Ce vāyāmo; Se vāyāmaṃ).
CPD: āyava , n. [ ts.; from āyu], strength, power, energy, manliness; appattassa pattiyā atthi ~aṃ, Paṭis l 107, 22 ( Ct.: atthi ~an ( v. l. āsavan) ti atthi viriyaṃ, Paṭis-a 338, 1 foll. ), but cf. S V 13, 6 appattassa pattiyā atthi āyāmaṃ ( Ct.: atthi vâyāman ti atthi viriyaṃ, Spk lll 130, 25 ).
